Cell.Text: Damn those stormcloaks to Oblivion! | They want liberate Skyrim, but those idiots can't understand what consequences this may have!

Node.Caption: lope_ElaraDialogues_playerMeetElaraTopic: Hello.

Cell.Text: Sorry, I just can't hold it. | I can't stand them!

Node.Caption: lope_ElaraDialogues_playerMeetElaraA1: That's interesting way to start conversation.

Cell.Text: Why should I? People like you must understand my position more than anyone else.
Why should I? Just don't tell me you support them.

Node.Caption: lope_ElaraDialogues_playerMeetElaraA2: Don't you afraid to say it in stormcloak's capital?

Cell.Text: *Laught* Let them try! I'll desintegrate anyone with thunderbolts and personally cut off the head of that disgusting pig they call a leader!

Node.Caption: lope_ElaraDialogues_playerMeetElaraA3v1: I don't, but it's might be dangerous, What if they punish you for thet?

Cell.Text: *Laught* Let them try! I'll desintegrate anyone with thunderbolts and personally cut off the head of that disgusting pig they call a leader!

Node.Caption: lope_ElaraDialogues_playerMeetElaraA3v2: Well I... But what if they punish you for such speaches?

Cell.Text: *Laught* Let them try! I'll desintegrate anyone with thunderbolts and personally cut off the head of that disgusting pig they call a leader!

Node.Caption: lope_ElaraDialogues_playerMeetElaraA3v3: Sure, they treat us like garbage, but what if they punish you for such speaches?

Cell.Text: Yes, sorry for that. | I didn't even introduce myself. | My name is Elara.

Node.Caption: lope_ElaraDialogues_playerMeetElaraA4: Right. Let's talk about something else?

Cell.Text: Mmm... which one of them? *Chuckles*

Node.Caption: lope_ElaraDialogues_playerMeetElaraA5: Sounds familiar. You wouldn't happen to be the author of that book, would you?

Cell.Text: Thanks, at least someone noticed. *Jiggles*

Node.Caption: lope_ElaraDialogues_playerMeetElaraA6: Moonlit Whispers. Pretty hot stuff you made.

Cell.Text: Oh, you're making me blush. | But yeah, with proper imagination I think you can describe anything.

Node.Caption: lope_ElaraDialogues_playerMeetElaraA7: That descriptions and details are incredible as well.

Cell.Text: *Jiggles* No, of course not. Why do you think so?

Node.Caption: lope_ElaraDialogues_playerMeetElaraA8: Only imagination? My friend and I were sure you descibing real experience.

Cell.Text: Knowing how that feels? How you can know how...

Node.Caption: lope_ElaraDialogues_playerMeetElaraA9: Well, because knowing how that feels.

Cell.Text: Oh, stop it. I appeciate you like my stories, but there's things can't be real.

Node.Caption: lope_ElaraDialogues_playerMeetElaraA10: Literally by doing it.

Cell.Text: Wow, that's... I thought it's only mine sick imagination, but if someone doing that for real?
No, really. My friend Maria and I doing it with dogs, and we enjoy it.
Wow, that's... I thought it's only mine sick imagination, but if someone doing that for real?
No, really. My friend Maria doing it with her dog, and I tryed and liked it too.
Wow, that's... I thought it's only mine sick imagination, but if someone doing that for real?

Node.Caption: lope_ElaraDialogues_playerMeetElaraA11: No, really. My friend Maria doing it with her dog, and she enjoys it.

Cell.Text: Well, that's good to know. | I guess, Don't know if that's really good to know.

Node.Caption: lope_ElaraDialogues_playerMeetElaraA12: Yeah, so your stories is a real life for other people.

Cell.Text: You mean... with dog? I... | Well, you know, then I was imagining things for my stories I was thinking about how I might feel, but... | I don't think I'm ready for that.

Node.Caption: lope_ElaraDialogues_playerMeetElaraA13: Maybe you would like to do it too?

Cell.Text: That's all right, my stories are not really common and pretty much not right to write too. | But still I write it. | Well, that was interesting conversation, wasn't it?

Node.Caption: lope_ElaraDialogues_playerMeetElaraA14: Sure, that's not really common and perhaps right thing to offer, sorry.

Cell.Text: If you'll like to chat some more in the future don't be a stranger, I think I'll not leave this place for a long time.
Yes, thanks for your time.
If you'll like to chat some more in the future don't be a stranger, I think I'll not leave this place for a long time.

Node.Caption: lope_ElaraDialogues_playerMeetElaraA15: Yes, thanks for your time.

Cell.Text: [S] G|Goodbye.

Node.Caption: lope_ElaraDialogues_playerMeetElaraA16: Sure, well see you then see you then?

Cell.Text: What could it possibly be?

Node.Caption: lope_ElaraDialogues_playerMeetElara_dogArenaOfferA1: You know, my friend and I have one idea, which could be a source of... inspiration for you.

Cell.Text: That's... interesting idea. But even with such precautions and concern for the safety of the dogs I still worry about their safety. | However I think I like how it sounds after all. | Where did you say you would like to place it?

Node.Caption: lope_ElaraDialogues_playerMeetElara_dogArenaOfferA2: (Describe idea about dog arena)

Cell.Text: A cave? You think it would be appropriate place for... | Well, I mean surely it would be appropriate for pit fight, but for visitors? | And I just thought, who but the bandits will be visiting such place? | There are more questions every minute.

Node.Caption: lope_ElaraDialogues_playerMeetElara_dogArenaOfferA3: At Cragslane cavern, cave in Eastmarch, just south of Windhelm.

Cell.Text: Hmm... Well, if we succeed with that idea this place could really be a great source of inspiration for my stories. | Ah, all right, count me in. I'll help you.

Node.Caption: lope_ElaraDialogues_playerMeetElara_dogArenaOfferA4: Yeah, but I think we can handle it. And that's why we need help.

Cell.Text: Well, you thank me after our place will be ready and operational. | I wonder what will come of it. | I'll move there to see what we can do.

Node.Caption: lope_ElaraDialogues_playerMeetElara_dogArenaOfferA5: Great! Thank you, Elara.

Cell.Text: [S] Later then.

Node.Caption: lope_ElaraDialogues_playerMeetElara_dogArenaOfferA6: All right, I'll meet you there.
